components.name: Primary Telemetry Action Button
components.description: High-contrast cyan action trigger used for flying to neighbor constellations and submitting data presets.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; background: #00F5D4; color: #050508; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #CCFF00; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00F5D4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Galaxy Scale Selector Segmented Control
components.description: Segmented preset selector in the bottom HUD allowing instant zero-reload switching between 50p, 150p, and 300p scales.
components.css: .ds-scale-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; background: rgba(5, 5, 8, 0.85); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-scale-label { color: #B8DCE8; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-scale-pill { padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #B8DCE8; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms ease; } .ds-scale-pill.active { background: #00F5D4; color: #050508; font-weight: 700; } .ds-scale-pill:hover:not(.active) { color: #F2F4F8; background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.12); }

components.name: Constellation Sector Pill
components.description: Sector navigation button displaying genre color dot, song volume, and user affinity percentage.
components.css: .ds-btn-sector { display: flex; width: 260px; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(5, 5, 8, 0.85); color: #B8DCE8; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-sector:hover { border-color: #00F5D4; color: #F2F4F8; transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-sector-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #00F5D4; } .ds-sector-meta { font-size: 11px; color: #CCFF00; }

components.name: Stellar Search Combobox

components.css: .ds-search-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 320px; } .ds-input-search { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; background: #090B12; color: #F2F4F8; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.35); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 56px 6px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: 2px solid #00F5D4; outline-offset: 2px; background: #050508; } .ds-kbd { position: absolute; right: 8px; background: #050508; color: #B8DCE8; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.3); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; }

narrative.overview: YourMusicVisualizer rejects flat streaming tables and generic dark-mode SaaS sidebars in favor of a live TouchDesigner audiovisual stage rig and volumetric 3D starfield. Every musical entity—genre constellation, artist star, and satellite track—is rendered as a luminous celestial body whose core radius scales logarithmically with song volume and whose bioluminescent corona scales non-linearly with listener affinity. The surrounding cosmos features continuous GPU fluid stardust flow, volume-scalable ionized nebulae, and calm, glare-free stellar inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed 100vw × 100dvh 3D WebGL starfield over deep void carbon (#050508).
Perimeter-docked technical HUD with pointer-events-none passthrough over the central 3D canvas.
Archival Yé-Yé Pop / record-sleeve artist inspection placards with square catalog portraits, spectral metrics, and Side-A tracklists.
Real-time 64-bin Web Audio FFT spectrum analysis driving 3D star respiration, cross-genre filament waves, and UnrealBloomPass intensity.
Continuous GPU fluid stardust flow with differential galactic rotation and volumetric 3D waves.
Song-count-scaled nebular nursery clouds with zero-disc Hermite-Gaussian falloffs.

rules.name: The Zero-Dead-Gray Rule
rules.body: Never place untinted neutral gray text (#888888, #999999) on dark cosmic surfaces; always use cyan-tinted Nebula Mist (#B8DCE8) so secondary readouts harmonize with the starfield and exceed 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.

rules.name: The Heading-Leads Rule
rules.body: Never place an eyebrow or kicker label above an h1, h2, or h3. The heading leads directly; catalog codes, affinity percentages, and spectral badges sit immediately below the heading.

rules.name: The 1px Hairline Frame Rule
rules.body: HUD panels are delineated by crisp 1px translucent cyan or magenta borders—never thick colored border-left stripes or heavy multi-layered drop shadows.

rules.name: The Steady-Luminosity Rule
rules.body: Approaching or selecting a celestial body must never cause blinding glare, white overexposure, or sudden bloom spikes. Luminosity remains calm and constant to ensure pristine legibility.

dos: Do scale every 3D star's radius logarithmically from song count (ln(1 + songCount)) and non-linearly from user affinity (affinity^1.5).
Do keep HUD panels docked to the viewport perimeter with pointer-events-none on wrapper containers so the central 3D cosmos remains directly draggable and clickable.
Do provide full keyboard navigation ('/' or Cmd+K search focus, ArrowUp/ArrowDown combobox traversal, Enter camera flight, Escape dismissal) and prefers-reduced-motion support.
Do dispose Web Audio nodes (stop(), disconnect()) and UnrealBloomPass render targets on track changes and component teardown.
Do scale sector nebulae volume and reach dynamically according to genre song count.
donts: Don't place kickers or eyebrows above h1, h2, or h3 headings; place metadata badges below the heading.
Don't use decorative section numbers (01 //, 02 //), thick colored border-left bars (> 1px), or unicode characters as substitutes for proper Lucide SVG icons.
Don't use Three.js <Html distanceFactor={...}> on 3D star labels, which causes giant perspective text scaling that collides with the 2D HUD.
Don't render rigid circular meshes or geometric discs around sector centers.
